note: Rive Kaštela (Tools/riva/riva_build.py): zone = where the photo-derived riva is built (game x0, z0, x1, z1); basins = sheltered harbour water forced to water (moored boats are not land); works = harbour works missing from coast.json (line + width, game x/z); parking = car parks digitised on the DGU DOF LiDAR 2022/23 mosaic (t_TX_TZ.png, game x/z), rows = bay rows (a -> b along the kerb, bays to the side 'side' (+1 = left of a->b in the game x/z plane), 2.5 m wide, 5 m deep)
